well_support: Identical radius 6 m blocks for operator and FE; final FE element-sampled fields, not native PointValue curves
decision_units: kg K/s; thermal-throughput proxy, not net power
feasibility: P90 injector absolute pressure <=50 MPa; any archived 72 MPa guard rejection makes that candidate FE-infeasible
scope: Two held-out geology groups, four paired members, nine independently crossed operating settings at fixed producer location; no depth sweep
